title: The tree that marks the desert
text: The Joshua tree is an indicator species of the Mojave Desert, and it is endemic to it. In Joshua Tree National Park, the western half is Mojave Desert and has thousands of Joshua trees. The eastern half, in the Colorado Desert, has ocotillo and smoketree instead.
